flows.title: Find a message in Activity
steps: Open the Activity tab of the relevant Message Stream.
Enter the recipient's address in the search bar to see all message events for that address, or use time-based filters or the Subject parameter to narrow the results.
Click the message in the Activity list to see all its events and when they occurred.

flows.title: Create a Message Stream
steps: Open the Postmark server where you want to add a stream.
Enter a Name and choose a Type: Transactional or Broadcast.
Click Create Message Stream to finish.

flows.title: Verify a sending domain
steps: Go to your Sender Signatures page.
Under the domain you're verifying, select DNS Settings or Add a DKIM DNS record.
In your DNS provider's area for DNS records, add a new TXT record using the Hostname and Value shown on the DNS Settings page.
Once the record propagates, DKIM will show as verified in your Postmark account, or click Verify to check manually.
